entity.name: Syed Subhan
entity.description: Creator and maintainer of Amicro, an open-source React micro-interactions and transition components library.

projects.name: Amicro
projects.description: Open-source React library of production-ready micro-interactions and transition components. Supports copy-paste and CLI/shadcn registry installation. Built with Motion and Tailwind.

plans.name: FOSS United Project Grant
plans.description: Support to improve accessibility (reduced-motion, keyboard, screen readers), mobile interactions, documentation, and expand micro-interaction primitives for common UI patterns.
